description: This file defines the enumeration 'LoopbackHost' with static methods to determine if a given hostname or IP address corresponds to local or loopback network addresses.

methods.name: isLoopback
methods.description: Checks if a hostname or IP address is a loopback address by delegating to 'isLoopbackHost'.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Determines if the provided hostname or IP address string is a loopback address.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkHost
methods.description: Checks if a hostname or IP address is within the local network or loopback.

methods.name: parseIPv4
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into a tuple of four UInt8 bytes.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Determines if a given IPv4 address is within known private or local network ranges.
